name: @that-simple/dotbrain
description: An open framework for working with AI agents in a code repository: lint, index and init for its brain.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings && tsc && node tools/dotbrain.ts lint && node tools/dotbrain.ts index --check && node tools/conformance/build-cases.ts --check && node --test 'tools/test/*.test.ts'
